item.title: Temporary Technical- VTS Staff TA
item.description: Temporary part‑time Research Assistant (VTS) in the Karan Jani Lab, supporting gravitational‑wave data analysis at Vanderbilt’s Department of Physics & Astronomy. | The Spatial Patterns and Access to Care for Engagement and HIV Suppression (SPACES) study is looking to hire a part-time Spanish-fluent Research Assistant. | The Principal UX Designer owns the university’s web design system and is accountable for the design work that shapes how audiences experience the university online, directing a small team of two freelance designers to deliver it. | The Web Engineering Manager is a hands-on technical leader within the Web Engineering and Ops team, part of the Communications and Marketing division at Vanderbilt. This position is responsible for architecting, building, and modernizing the university’s web applications and digital products, with a primary emphasis on front- and back-end engineering, systems integration, and AI-enabled ways of working.

item.title: Web Engineering Manager
item.description: The Web Engineering Manager is a hands-on technical leader within the Web Engineering and Ops team, part of the Communications and Marketing division at Vanderbilt. This position is responsible for architecting, building, and modernizing the university’s web applications and digital products, with a primary emphasis on front- and back-end engineering, systems integration, and AI-enabled ways of working.
